titles.title: 28 Hotel Rooms
titles.plot: A night of casual sex between a New York novelist (Chris Messina) and an accountant (Marin Ireland) from Seattle unexpectedly leads to a long-distance relationship that lasts for several years.

titles.title: A Man of Integrity
titles.plot: Reza, having distanced himself from the urban quagmire, leads a simple life along with his wife and young son, somewhere in a remote village in Northern Iran. He spends his days working on his goldfish farm. Nearby, a private company with close links to the government and local authorities, has taken control of nearly every aspect of regional life. Its shareholders, accumulating wealth, power and economic influence, have been pushing local farmers and small owners to sell off their belongings, farms and estates, to the benefit of the Company's influential network and its monopoly. It is under their pressure that many villagers have themselves become local links in the larger network of corruption.

titles.title: Cherry
titles.plot: A teenager (Ashley Hinshaw) takes the money she earned for a photo shoot and runs away to San Francisco, where she catches the eye of both a lawyer (James Franco) and a lesbian porn director (Heather Graham).

titles.title: Acquainted
titles.plot: Former classmates run into each other at a bar and form an unexpected bond.

titles.title: All Creatures Here Below
titles.plot: Gensan and Ruby struggle to thrive in the face of abject poverty. When Gensan loses his job and gambles his last paycheck, he sets in motion a series of events with dire consequences. Racing across the country, they seek refuge in their hometown of Kansas City, a place filled with the dark secrets that have haunted them since they fled years ago.

titles.title: Àma Gloria
titles.plot: Six year old Cléo loves her nanny Gloria more than anything. When Gloria must suddenly return to Cape Verde to care for her own children, Cléo makes her promise that they will see each other very soon. Gloria invites Cléo to her island and the two must make the most of their last summer together.

titles.title: Among Ravens
titles.plot: Friends reunite for a holiday weekend and meet a mysterious nature photographer (Will McCormack) who changes their lives one by one when he bonds with a couple's young daughter.

titles.title: August: Surprise Door
titles.plot: A riveting story about a former high school track athlete who's distorted views on love, negatively affects the people closest to him. All things come to a head when an unexpected person shows up behind a Surprise Door.

titles.title: August: Web of Lies
titles.plot: A riveting story about a former high school track athlete who's distorted views on love, negatively affects the people closest to him. Trust and a Web of Lies fills August's world blinding him from the truth about himself.

titles.title: Augustine
titles.plot: In 1885, Professor Charcot studies an illness that causes hysteria. He meets Augustine -- barely out of childhood -- and as he becomes obsessed with her, she tries harder and harder to seduce him.

titles.title: Beaches
titles.plot: Two youngsters meet on the Venice Boardwalk and embark on a lifelong friendship.

titles.title: Concrete Night
titles.plot: A 14-year-old Finn learns poor life lessons from his brother before the latter's incarceration.

titles.title: Bird Atlas
titles.plot: An ageing proprietor of a technology company discovers that someone within the company has been embezzling funds and his suppliers haven't been paid for months.

titles.title: Burning Sands
titles.plot: Zurich Condoll (Trevor Jackson) is a student at Frederick Douglass University and is proud to be a pledge at a famous African-American fraternity. But anti-hazing rules have driven his Hell Week underground, and the veteran members of his fraternity have degenerated into a pack of vicious, drunken, sadistic louts.

titles.title: Closeness
titles.plot: A poor Jewish couple in Russia face a series of devastating choices when their youngest son and his bride-to-be are kidnapped and held for ransom.

titles.title: Crush
titles.plot: A young woman takes her unusual obsession for a married man to the next level when she strikes up a friendship with his oblivious wife.

titles.title: Disclosure
titles.plot: Parents viciously confront one another when a 4-year-old girl makes a serious allegation against a politician's 9-year-old son.

titles.title: Endings, Beginnings
titles.plot: A Los Angeles woman unlocks the secrets to her life after meeting two handsome best friends at a party.

titles.title: Envy
titles.plot: A reformed gangster-turned-successful businessman seeks a new romantic interest while contending with an envious drug lord and an infamous rival.

titles.title: Feral
titles.plot: At once an examination of loneliness and the masks we wear to face the world, Andrew Wonder's FERAL tells the story of Yasmine, a young woman living in the tunnels underneath Manhattan, struggling to overcome her past as she meets other city dwellers fending for their own lives.

titles.title: Fi & Queen B
titles.plot: A tragedy strikes just when a young man is about to propose to his girlfriend.

titles.title: For Ellen
titles.plot: A struggling musician (Paul Dano) tries to pull himself together and fight for shared custody of his young daughter (Shaylena Mandigo).

titles.title: Gabrielle
titles.plot: Wealthy but arrogant writer Jean Hervey (Pascal Greggory) comes home one day to find that his wife, Gabrielle (Isabelle Huppert), has left him for another man. Realizing her mistake, Gabrielle returns, and the pair begin a merciless analysis of their marriage as the relationship comes undone.

titles.title: Good Bad Things
titles.plot: Danny, a young man with muscular dystrophy who is disillusioned by failed relationships, steps out of his comfort zone and into the world of online dating. An unexpected match with Madi, an enigmatic photographer, challenges him to be vulnerable and sparks a profound journey of self-acceptance, discovering the extraordinary beauty of his unique body.

titles.title: Grigris
titles.plot: Grigris dreams of being a dancer despite his paralyzed leg.

titles.title: Guest Artist
titles.plot: A young man explores the tangled relationship between the dreams of youth and the wisdom of age when he meets his hero, a bitter playwright.

titles.title: Hail Mary
titles.plot: Mary went from having everything to losing it all within a blink of an eye. She taps into her inner hustle to help her get back on her feet. What starts off as a temporary hustle leads to a path of destruction.

titles.title: Hannah
titles.plot: A woman grapples with the consequences of her husband's imprisonment.

titles.title: In the City of Sylvia
titles.plot: A man returns to a city to track down a woman he met there six years ago.

titles.title: Inversion
titles.plot: An unmarried woman in Tehran seeks the courage she needs to stand up to her family and pursue her own dreams.

titles.title: Like Sunday, Like Rain
titles.plot: A struggling musician becomes a 12-year-old musical prodigy's guardian for a summer.

titles.title: Lily
titles.plot: As she wanders the streets of New York, a cancer survivor re-evaluates a relationship with an older lover and confronts her feelings about her long-absent father.

titles.title: Little Vera
titles.plot: Vera lives with her mother and drunken father in a high-rise tenement that resembles a prison. She doesn't know what she wants to do with her life, but has little faith in the decaying socialist system. She turns to alcohol, drugs and dancing. A tryst with a handsome student, Sergei, promises a way out, but it too leaves her trapped. When the time comes to choose between Sergei and her family, Vera is unsure if either is a good option.

titles.title: Mademoiselle Chambon
titles.plot: A happily married man volunteers at his son's school and begins to fall in love with a teacher.

titles.title: Michael Inside
titles.plot: An 18-year-old is sentenced to three months in prison after he is caught holding drugs.

titles.title: Mond
titles.plot: A former martial artist from Austria is hired to train a wealthy Jourdanian family, but once she arrives, she is unsettled by how the women are treated.

titles.title: Monsieur Hire
titles.plot: A love-starved outcast develops an unusual relationship with the seductive young neighbor he's been spying upon.

titles.title: Mulk
titles.plot: A Muslim family tries to reclaim its lost honor.

titles.title: Natasha
titles.plot: A forbidden romance develops in Toronto between a 16-year-old Russian Jewish immigrant and his 14-year-old cousin.

titles.title: Noi the Albino
titles.plot: Seventeen-year-old Nói (Tómas Lemarquis), an albino, lives with his grandmother, Lina (Anna Fridriksdottir), in an isolated town in Iceland. Bright but bored with a life that offers no possibility of change or excitement, Nói amuses himself by antagonizing teachers and administrators at school, which angers his father, Kiddi (Þröstur Leó Gunnarsson). His daily routine is brightened by the arrival of Iris (Elin Hansdottir), a young gas station attendant Nói dreams of running away with.

titles.title: Nostalgia
titles.plot: After living 40 years abroad, Felice returns to Naples and discovers again places and codes of the city, facing a past that eats him away.

titles.title: Not Today
titles.plot: A privileged young man (Cody Longo) travels to India and has an encounter with a starving child and her father that changes his life forever.

titles.title: One Summer of Happiness
titles.plot: A clergyman opposes a recent college graduate's romance with a neighboring farmer's daughter.

titles.title: Paradise: Faith
titles.plot: A devout woman's (Maria Hofstätter) faith holds that she bow to the demands of her partially paralyzed, tyrannical husband (Nabil Saleh).

titles.title: Paradise: Love
titles.plot: A middle-aged woman travels to Kenya in search of sex.

titles.title: Qissa
titles.plot: A Sikh man tries to start a new life for his family while hiding their true identities during the ethnic cleansing in 1947.

titles.title: Rock Steady Row
titles.plot: A college freshman is compelled to take action against the reigning fraternities and the dean after his bike is stolen.

titles.title: Round of Your Life
titles.plot: When a car accident leaves his father in a coma, a 15-year-old prodigy joins his high school golf team to try and win the state title for his dad.

titles.title: Running Against the Wind
titles.plot: Two twelve-year-old boys grow up together in a remote village -- until a single photo changes their lives forever: Solomon heads for Addis Ababa to become a photographer. Abdi remains at home and trains to fulfil his dream of matching the sport successes of Haile Gebrselassie. Ten years later, Abdi is nominated for the Ethiopian National Running Team and moves to Addis Ababa. He feels Solomon must be dead by now, but an inner voice tells him to look for his old friend. And in fact Solomon is still alive, but in a complete different world to Abdi's with his story of success. Abdi's source of power is his running shoes -- Solomon survives thanks to his wife Genet and the love of his three-year-old daughter Fikir.

titles.title: Simon Killer
titles.plot: A recent college graduate (Brady Corbet) takes a trip to Paris, becomes involved with a hooker (Mati Diop) and unleashes his dark side.

titles.title: Sivas
titles.plot: A young boy finds a wounded dog in a ditch and nurses it back to health.

titles.title: Texas Heart
titles.plot: After fleeing his mob connections in New York, a corrupt attorney takes refuge in a small Texas town. As he adjusts, he begins to see powerful new reasons to better himself and help others.

titles.title: Tharlo
titles.plot: Tharlo meets a girl in the barbershop who changes the course of his life. After he decides to sell all of his sheep and use the money to go out into the world with the woman, he finds himself being deceived and cheated by her.

titles.title: The Desert Bride
titles.plot: Teresa's life begins to fall apart when the family that employs her decides to sell their house.

titles.title: The Man of My Life
titles.plot: A happily married man (Bernard Campan) feels an unexpected attraction to a gay neighbor.

titles.title: The Price
titles.plot: Seyi, a 24-year-old Nigerian-American working on Wall Street, is caught engaging in insider trading. When his entire world comes crashing down, he is forced to finally confront his tumultuous relationships.

titles.title: The Rainbow Experiment
titles.plot: Things spiral out of control in a high school when a terrible accident involving a science experiment injures a student for life.

titles.title: The Whistleblower
titles.plot: The experiences of Kathryn Bolkovac, a cop from Nebraska, who worked as a peacekeeper in post-war Bosnia and exposed a U.N. sex scandal that was covered up.

titles.title: Who's Cheating Who?
titles.plot: Stephanie is not happily married to Mason, who is cheating on her with Melanie; Melanie's husband, Steven meets Stephanie and begins a tentative affair with her, catching all four of them in a web of desire, guilt, adultery, and accusations.

titles.title: Wild
titles.plot: After an encounter with a wolf, a young woman (Lilith Stangenberg) casts off societal conventions to live a life free of hypocrisy.
